name: 30281 · Stockbridge, GA
findings: ZIP 30281 (Stockbridge) has 350 nonprofit organizations. 103 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30281 (Stockbridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30281 (Stockbridge) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 37 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
